messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — Orbit POC kicked off this morning. Customer (Lee) needs a hosted API key for a 2-week trial. Prefer an ephemeral flow with rotation + ability to revoke immediately if needed. cc @alex_se @jordan_security

alex_se: We can do a short-lived hosted API key. Recommendation: 7d TTL with a plan to rotate at day 3 (create new key, swap, revoke old). Add metadata tags: poc=orbit, owner=maria_sales so we can track usage. If they need IP allowlist we can enable that.

lee_customer: We can't guarantee static egress IPs on our side, so IP allowlist is not an option. We just need easy rotation and immediate revoke capability. Also want usage caps to avoid surprises.

jordan_security: For POCs security baseline: short TTL (<=14d), audit logs turned on, no long-lived creds in SSM/email. Approve 7d ephemeral for this POC. Provide a revocation & rotation playbook to the customer.

alex_se: Steps to create programmatically (SE/devs):
```
# create ephemeral key (example)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_SECRETS" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"name":"orbit-poc-ephemeral","ttl":"7d","tags":["poc:orbit","owner:maria_sales"],"quota_tokens":100000}'
```
To revoke: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/<KEY_ID>/revoke \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_SECRETS"
```
Also you can create the key via Console -> API Keys -> New Key -> set TTL and tags, enable "audit logging" and "usage quota".

sam_platform_ops: Make sure we attach a per-key soft quota (100k tokens) and a route policy to avoid routing to large costly models. For POC use `gpt-small` family or a quantized variant to keep unit cost low. Also enable rate limit 60rps for the key.

maria_sales: I'll create the dashboard key with tags and quota, then send a secure expiring link to Lee (we use signed links, not raw API keys in email). Lee — once you get it, try a quick embeddings call and reply here.

devops-bot: Key created (id: key_orbit_01abc, created_by: maria_sales, expires_in: 7d, quota: 100000 tokens).

lee_customer: Received the link, did a smoke test: embeddings endpoint works, latency ~120ms, usage shows in Console. Thanks.

jordan_security: Rotation playbook (high level):
- Day 0: create ephemeral key A (7d), tag it, enable quota + audit logs.
- Day 3: create ephemeral key B, switch client to B during a low-traffic window. Verify calls for 30m.
- Day 3+: revoke key A and confirm 401s for old key.
- If rollback needed: re-enable A and revoke B.
Make sure to note key IDs and have a copy in the secure rotation ticket (SE/Sales-run).

alex_se: I'll drop a link to the playbook and a short script to automate rotation. Also remind: never embed keys in code or logs. Use env vars / secret manager. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/poc/ephemeral-keys (internal).

maria_sales: :thumbsup: I'll run rotation on day 3 and post an incident-style note when old key is revoked. Closing loop with customer once POC ends — will request final revocation and export of audit logs.

lee_customer: Sounds good. One more ask: can you add "poc:orbit" to the audit logs so we can map our calls?

jordan_security: Already set — we record tags in the audit events. We'll hand over the audit snippet at end-of-poc.

maria_sales: Great, thanks everyone. I'll update the CRM with key id and expiry. cc @sam_platform_ops for quota monitoring.

sam_platform_ops: I'll keep an eye on the key usage and set an alert at 80% of token quota.

maria_sales: Thanks — closing thread once revocation is confirmed. :white_check_mark:
